description: Find an icon for a need or a word, e.g. "delete", "go back" or "warning" (52 icons, 16px outline). Matches names, synonyms and use text. Use this instead of drawing or inventing SVGs. Leave query empty and pass a category (actions, navigation, objects, status) to list one category.

limit.description: Default 8 for a query; with no query, every icon (or every icon of the category)

name: search_icons
title: Search icons
